items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: Dizzy Gillespie was working in a joint, and so on, right on down the street.

ctx.x: That's right. Down First, Second, Third Street, around that area there. It was a place called Shep's Playhouse. So we worked there over the Christmas vacations that particular year, which was 1945, and we left and took a train into Chicago and played a couple of dates around that area. and then took a train on into New York and went to work to Three Deuces on 52nd Street, which was very interesting, because we were working for Three Deuces and next door, Art Tatum was working at a joint and next door to him,…
was very good. I stayed with Eddie Haywood until April of 1946.
